title: Residency pin heuristics dashboard and legal-ready evidence batcher
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a product surface and backend workflow that surfaces residency pin heuristics (explicit pin, soft-affinity, tenant-preferences) in a single dashboard, and implements a scheduled evidence-batcher that compiles legally-friendly residency bundles for pinned requests. Goal: reduce time-to-evidence for compliance audits and make pin decisions transparent to platform operators and legal reviewers.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows per-tenant pin state, pin precedence, and recent routing decisions for the last 30 days
Evidence-batcher produces a signed artifact (zip) containing request sample, routing proof, retention TTLs, and region metadata
Batcher supports on-demand run and scheduled daily/weekly runs with configurable retention windows
Operators can filter dashboard by tenant, endpoint, and time range and export a compliance bundle
End-to-end tests verifying fallback routing and evidence inclusion exist in ENG repo and pass in CI
decision_log: 2026-02-24: Decided to implement heuristics visibility instead of changing routing logic in first iteration to reduce blast radius
2026-03-02: Legal requested evidence artifact include canonical model version, region ASN metadata, and KMS key identifier — accepted
2026-03-08: Opted for daily batched artifacts with pointer manifests to avoid duplicating large request payloads; payloads remain accessible through signed pointers for 90 days
